title: HCM-2.3 closed generic artifact control records
$comment: This schema admits one control record at a time. Cross-record publication authority additionally requires the deterministic atomic_publication_matrix_checker, publication_chain_contracts, windows_ntcreatefile_relative_open_contract, and windows_ntfscontrolfile_object_id_contract in generic-artifact-control-vectors-v1.0.json; schema-valid records without those exact matrix, chain, ABI, fingerprint, and semantic validations are non-authoritative.

object_id_query.$comment: This summary is admissible only when the exact private synchronous NtFsControlFile ABI/trace contract proves one of three exact absence traces: immediate raw STATUS_OBJECTID_NOT_FOUND with the complete IO_STATUS_BLOCK unchanged at its initialized STATUS_UNSUCCESSFUL/ULONG_PTR_MAX sentinel; matching raw/final STATUS_OBJECTID_NOT_FOUND with zero Information; or raw STATUS_PENDING completed through IO_STATUS_BLOCK as STATUS_OBJECTID_NOT_FOUND with zero Information. Pending with either sentinel unchanged, every other sentinel or disagreement, DeviceIoControl/GetLastError, success/present output, or any other status is non-authoritative and fails closed.

platform_primitive.$comment: The setfileinformationbyhandle_filerenameinfo_* values are frozen compatibility identifiers for the two Windows retained-handle no-replace modes. They do not authorize or name the current FFI; the native adapter uses local NtSetInformationFile(FileRenameInformation) inside publish_replacement.
